x: He was also second in the Weight (37ft. 0in.) and narrowly beaten for third place in the Long Jump, with 19ft. 10in. H.
Shepherd win a good race off 16 yards, with Bill Pritchard, off 8 yards, second, and Syd Jarlett (12) gaining another success by being third. The Club Long Jump handicap was won by H.
He cleared 5ft. 5in., and a junior, Len Marchant, was second with 5ft. 3in.; he will undoubtedly get higher, as his physique is well suited to this event. H.
We then had 10 more more "Bels" before the first London man, who was Alonzo, a member of the Blackheath Harriers. The second London man was none other than our own Junior Captain, H.
Powell and Ron Jeal are a useful quartet, whilst our Club champion, H.
